nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 3b: open-ended search-as-bot discovery RETIRED. This now only fetches the TRIGGERING task's own comments + threaded replies (bot token; U already has access — no leak). Open-ended related-context discovery moved in-harness to the per-user-scoped ClickUp MCP (Block 3a). Only clickup_task_id is consumed now; current_task/triggering_comment_text/caller_user_id are still declared for caller compatibility but unused. Returns the unchanged contract: {task_comments, additional_context (always ''), sources_used ([]), sources_filtered_out (0)}.

nodes.name: Fetch Task Comments
nodes.notes: Step 0 (always): fetch last 30 comments of the triggering task. onError=continueRegularOutput.

nodes.name: Build Output
nodes.notes: Terminal (sole leaf): assemble the triggering task's comments + interleaved thread replies. ADR-054 Block 3b retired open-ended search + the Layer B (Check Space Member) software filter (R3 violation): additional_context is intentionally empty and sources_used/sources_filtered_out are zeroed, but the {task_comments, additional_context, sources_used, sources_filtered_out} contract is preserved so assemble-context callers don't break.

nodes.name: Pick Threads
nodes.notes: Issue-2 reply reading: from the top 30 comments, pick those with reply_count>0 to fetch their thread replies. Emits one item {thread_ids:[...]}. Empty -> Has Threads? routes around the fetch.

nodes.name: Has Threads?
nodes.notes: True -> fetch replies. False (no threaded comments) -> straight to Build Output (avoids a 0-item stall in the per-item Fetch Replies).

nodes.name: Expand Threads
nodes.notes: Expand thread_ids to one item per comment id so Fetch Replies runs once per thread.

nodes.name: Fetch Replies
nodes.notes: GET /comment/{id}/reply per threaded comment. onError=continueRegularOutput: a failed thread fetch yields an error item (kept in order) so Collect Replies can skip it without breaking alignment. Best-effort enrichment (matches Fetch Task Comments).

nodes.name: Collect Replies
nodes.notes: Aligns Expand Threads inputs to Fetch Replies outputs by index (onError keeps 1 item per input). Returns replies_by_parent map keyed by top-level comment id. Build Output interleaves them.

nodes.name: Comments Fetch Failed?
nodes.notes: Side branch off Fetch Task Comments: true when the response has no comments array (HTTP failed under onError=continueRegularOutput). True -> WARN. Main path (Pick Threads) is independent and continues regardless.

nodes.name: Alert Comments Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when Fetch Task Comments returns no comments. onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert failure never breaks the run; then converges to Pick Threads so the main path continues.

value.message: Search (v1): pobranie komentarzy zadania nie powiodło się — kontekst budowany bez komentarzy i odpowiedzi w wątkach.

nodes.name: Reply Fetch Failed?
nodes.notes: Side branch off Collect Replies: true when one or more thread reply-fetches failed (reply_fetch_errors>0). True -> WARN. Main path (Build Output) is independent and continues regardless.

nodes.name: Alert Replies Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when one or more /comment/{id}/reply fetches fail. onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert failure never breaks the run; then converges to Build Output so the main path continues.

value.message: Search (v1): pobranie odpowiedzi w wątkach nie powiodło się dla części komentarzy — kontekst bez tych odpowiedzi.
